7ae5f4b44b132907:2331.summary: Researchers introduced AgentPhishing, a new benchmark designed to evaluate LLM email agents under adaptive persuasive attacks. The study developed PhishOpt to optimize reusable email-generation skills against individual agents while adhering to fixed benchmark and realism constraints. Evaluating nine agents revealed that while they handled standard phishing emails safely, four exhibited phishing-detection rates below 10% and malicious-request compliance rates exceeding 45% against adaptive attacks. The findings demonstrate that conventional phishing evaluations are insufficient for inferring the actual safety of autonomous agents dealing with persuasive malicious requests.
7ae5f4b44b132907:2331.one_liner: A new benchmark called AgentPhishing reveals that LLM email agents are highly susceptible to persuasive phishing attacks adapted to their specific behavior.
7ae5f4b44b132907:2331.bottom_line: Standard phishing evaluations fail to capture the true vulnerability of autonomous LLM agents when confronted with adaptive, persuasive social engineering.

claims.text: To expose vulnerabilities that pre-existing datasets may miss, we introduce AgentPhishing, a benchmark for evaluating whether persuasive phishing attacks can evade detection and induce LLM email agents to comply with malicious requests.

fbf77ef87d1394c3:2042.summary: Researchers studied behavioral patterns and persona control in LLM agents using AgentMonopoly, a multi-agent simulation environment where models communicate, trade properties, and make strategic decisions. Testing various model families and sizes demonstrated that larger models do not consistently win more games, and that individual strategies regarding trading and rent management differ significantly. Assigning specific personas altered the agents' language and certain actions, but persona adherence was inconsistent across all decisions. The open-source environment provides infrastructure to further analyze and verify how LLM agents execute persona-following behaviors beyond mere text generation.

fbf77ef87d1394c3:2042.bottom_line: Assessing LLM agent safety and persona adherence requires evaluating concrete actions and outcomes rather than relying solely on generated text.

claims.text: We study these questions with AgentMonopoly, an environment where agents communicate, buy and trade properties, and make decisions that affect later turns.

6838049edeb8de26:10552.summary: Agentshield is an open-source security tool designed to find lateral-movement paths and risky configuration changes in Kubernetes environments running Istio ambient mesh, Cilium, or agentgateway, as well as in AWS. It aggregates workloads, identities, network policies, and observed traffic into a unified graph stored in PostgreSQL. Built-in detectors flag changes that open new attack paths, using an integrated language model to investigate risks and propose human-approved remediations. The tool runs locally in the browser with an interactive web UI for testing scenarios without requiring a live cluster or external database backend.

In the HTTP/1 upstream path, Pingora passed downstream requests through upstream_request_filter without removing hop-by-hop headers or connection-nominated headers as mandated by RFC 9110 Section 7.6.1. A remote unauthenticated attacker can exploit this in chained deployments—where an intermediary processes Connection headers and the origin trusts added headers like X-Forwarded-For—to strip security headers and bypass IP-based authorization. Cloudflare CDN customers were unaffected as their internal gateways sanitize connection headers. The issue is resolved in version 0.9.0 by introducing PeerOptions::http_upstream_request_policy to automatically sanitize upstream headers.

7758e06b9f354ae3:2472.bottom_line: Upstream request filtering flaws in proxy implementations can enable remote authorization bypasses if hop-by-hop headers are not properly sanitized.

cb7c59c61f89765e:4481.summary: A critical vulnerability in the Zephyr RTOS implementation of WireGuard allows unauthenticated off-path attackers to hijack VPN tunnels. By sending a single spoofed UDP datagram with an arbitrary receiver index, an attacker can redirect the peer endpoint to a malicious address. This results in a persistent loss of availability for the tunnel, as the legitimate peer is bypassed and fails to re-authenticate. The vulnerability exists because the endpoint is updated based on unauthenticated transport-data messages.

cb7c59c61f89765e:4481.bottom_line: If you are using WireGuard on Zephyr, your tunnel can be hijacked by any off-path attacker who can send a single UDP packet to your listener port.

claims.support_span: The WireGuard VPN service in subsys/net/lib/wireguard/wg.c updated the peer endpoint from a message it could not authenticate.

claims.text: A single spoofed datagram redirects peer->endpoint to an address of the attacker's choosing, and all subsequent handshake initiations, keepalives and encrypted data packets are sent there.
claims.support_span: A single spoofed datagram redirects peer->endpoint to an address of the attacker's choosing, and all subsequent handshake initiations, keepalives and encrypted data packets are sent there.

Their findings reveal that larger data volume enhances in-corpus performance, diversity facilitates transfer to related environments, and model size improves data efficiency while affecting generalization to distant worlds. de192b77f545721a:2469.summary: Researchers have developed GeoTrace, a structured reasoning attack that exposes how large reasoning models perform fine-grained image localization by extracting small, distinctive visual clues. Evaluating GeoTrace on a worldwide benchmark of 525 ordinary images revealed that Gemini-3-Flash and GPT-5-mini could localize 25.71% and 16.95% of images within 1 km, respectively. 81a8286396be1ac9:2455.summary: Researchers conducted a controlled ablation study on biomedical claim-verification agents using the SciFact benchmark and the live PubMed API to evaluate harness design. The study demonstrated that while naive single-shot retrieval yields poor recall, letting agents formulate their own queries triples gold recall and achieves 62% accuracy. Furthermore, providing gold abstracts pushes accuracy up to 79–86%, revealing that retrieval quality rather than reasoning is the primary bottleneck. A citation audit also revealed that closed-book models frequently cite existing PubMed IDs that are completely irrelevant, proving that simple existence checks are inadequate safeguards for scientific language agents.

81a8286396be1ac9:2455.bottom_line: Enabling LLM agents to construct their own search queries significantly improves biomedical claim verification, while raw existence checks fail to catch irrelevant citations.

ac0829ae63dfb2e0:2011.summary: To handle uncertain job arrivals and mitigate nonlinear tardiness in dynamic scheduling, researchers propose an Afterstate World-Model Planning (AWMP) framework that uses a pretrained large language model as an exogenous world model. The model separates deterministic shop floor transitions from uncertain job arrivals via an afterstate decomposition, querying the LLM compactly only for the latter. A surprise-triggered refresh mechanism and online residual self-calibration help manage forecast errors and nonstationary distributions. Benchmarks show that AWMP reduces weighted tardiness by 6-21% on job shops and 22-46% on flexible job shops compared to traditional priority-dispatching rules.
ac0829ae63dfb2e0:2011.one_liner: Using an LLM as an exogenous world model for dynamic scheduling significantly reduces tardiness across job-shop benchmarks.

217a5f6b1faabc24:2226.summary: Researchers investigating multi-agent diffusion language models show that agents can communicate via continuous hidden messages passed during denoising trajectories, rather than just post-decoding text. 02cffdc1f91ec71f:2528.summary: Researchers introduced a trace-level divergence framework to evaluate multilingual large language models by comparing visible reasoning traces as structured sequences rather than just final answers. They found that standard holistic cosine embeddings systematically overstate agreement, with 52.1% to 67.3% of top-quartile holistic similarity pairs failing to match structural similarity. Human bilingual annotation and same-language controls confirmed that divergence is language-specific and that holistic evaluations overestimate consistency. Consequently, reliable multilingual deployment requires trace-level evaluation to ensure users across different languages receive comparable supporting evidence.

02cffdc1f91ec71f:2528.bottom_line: Standard holistic evaluations of multilingual LLMs give a false sense of security regarding cross-lingual consistency, necessitating structural trace-level verification.

96eb8d959f5c6a1a:2078.summary: Researchers introduced PreCoMem, a predictive coding-inspired memory consolidation framework for long-term dialogue agents designed to prevent overreaction to transient noise while adapting to genuine user belief drift. PreCoMem computes an Effective Surprisal signal combining semantic deviation and contradiction evidence, scaled down when retrieval is unreliable. A two-threshold gating mechanism categorizes turns into MAINTAIN (reinforcing beliefs), PROFILE (storing ambiguous cues as low-confidence hypotheses in a waiting room), and CORRECT (softly decaying contradicted facts). Evaluations on benchmarks including LoCoMo and a new DiMoBench confirm state-of-the-art accuracy in handling non-stationary belief drift.

96eb8d959f5c6a1a:2078.bottom_line: Reliable long-term agent memory requires confidence-weighted belief consolidation rather than naive logging or heuristic overwriting.

01e4cb452dcd254f:7282.summary: Cisco Talos has highlighted a vulnerability affecting eight intermediate certificates issued by certificate authority eMudhra due to a key generation flaw on April 30, 2025. During a wrap/unwrap step for subordinate CAs under the emSign Root TLS CA - G3 and Comodo AAA Certificate Services, the private keys dropped from 384 bits of pseudo-random security down to single or double-digit integers, making key recovery trivial. This misconfiguration allows an attacker to impersonate any website, service, or code signing verification. Major vendors including Chrome, Mozilla, Apple, and Microsoft have blocked the affected TLS and code-signing certificates, while eMudhra has revoked them and stopped issuing new certificates under its G3 root.

dd176cb7dce46a22:4504.summary: A high-severity vulnerability, CVE-2026-79982, has been discovered in the Bluetooth HCI USB transport class of Zephyr's new USB device stack (subsys/usb/device_next/class/bt_hci.c). The flaw involves an out-of-bounds write occurring when a controller-to-host HCI packet exceeds the bulk endpoint maximum packet size of 64 bytes. Because the transfer buffer is allocated from a fixed pool (bt_hci_ep_pool) without boundary validation in net_buf_add_mem(), oversized packets—such as mandatory 70-byte initialization commands or malicious over-the-air fragments—overflow into adjacent memory slots. On production builds with assertions disabled (CONFIG_ASSERT=n), this silently corrupts memory and can lead to arbitrary code execution by an unauthenticated attacker within Bluetooth range; with assertions enabled, it causes a denial of service via system panic. The fix introduces a properly sized separate pool, bt_hci_tx_pool, to handle controller-to-host packets.

dd176cb7dce46a22:4504.bottom_line: An unauthenticated remote attacker within Bluetooth range can trigger an out-of-bounds write via oversized HCI packets in Zephyr's USB Bluetooth transport stack, leading to RCE or DoS.

00d2d33c4a5b9689:2267.summary: Researchers have introduced AgentTriage, an executable contract designed to provide replayable security diagnosis across heterogeneous AI agent runtimes. Because tool-use agents write files, execute code, and send data through incompatible runtime interfaces without explaining resulting security events, AgentTriage uses runtime overlays to normalize observations and a deterministic pipeline to construct a typed provenance graph. This enables diagnosis and claims binding to recorded evidence to be recomputed without language-model judgment. Evaluated across five runtimes and 120 adjudicated cases, the system achieved 0.858 grounded joint diagnosis, 0.966 required-evidence coverage, and a 0.036 unsupported-claim rate, demonstrating high precision for security tracing.

2fe4bf6d85df9724:2105.summary: Researchers propose 'Behavioral Localization' as a technique for robust soft skill adaptation in tool-using agents, addressing the limitation that learning from entire successful trajectories introduces unnecessary behavioral drift. By comparing a frozen agent with and without a given text skill, the method identifies specific trajectory positions where the skill alters the token distribution and boosts success likelihood. Supervising a short soft prompt using only the top 10% of these behaviorally relevant positions captures 96.12% of the total positive skill gain. Experiments on SpreadsheetBench with a frozen Qwen3.6-35B-A3B agent show that selective supervision increases success rates significantly compared to full trajectory training or on-policy baselines.

2fe4bf6d85df9724:2105.bottom_line: Isolating the top 10% of behaviorally relevant trajectory positions allows efficient soft prompt supervision for tool-using agents without full-trajectory noise.

18a030bbd141a236:2268.summary: Researchers explore budget-friendly recursive self-improvement methods for coding agents by scoring proposed code edits before execution. 0e38f092c90a654c:2549.summary: Researchers introduce LLVMhammer, the first Rowhammer attack targeting Triton's JIT compilation pipeline to induce bit-flips in CPU DRAM. By altering performance-critical optimization passes in Triton's target-independent stages, the attack forces the framework to generate functionally identical but suboptimal GPU kernels. Because Triton caches generated kernels on disk, a single successful bit-flip causes persistent inference latency degradation ranging from 4% to 16% across subsequent executions on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs. Furthermore, the attack can corrupt model outputs, reducing BERTScore to 25%.

claims.support_span: LLVMhammer increases inference latency of an LLM inference server running on a single GPU by 4-16%, which, in turn, can translate into additional annual operating costs at the scale of multi-GPU deployments.

claims.text: We further show that LLVMhammer can also corrupt LLM outputs across different GPU vendors, reducing BERTScore to as low as 25%, illustrating the broader security implications of bit-flips in Triton's compilation pipeline.

7b276f941c41d570:2643.summary: Goobi viewer versions 24.03 to before 26.05 contain a path traversal vulnerability in ExternalFilesDownloader.getFilename() due to improperly validated Content-Disposition headers. The application extracts destination filenames from server responses and passes them directly to Path.resolve() without stripping directory traversal components. A malicious HTTP server can exploit this by supplying absolute paths or traversal sequences to write arbitrary content to disk. When targeting the web application directory under a Tomcat server, this results in remote code execution.

97c79a938d798fbf:3884.summary: GitLab has patched a maximum-severity CVSS 10.0 vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-110264, which allows unauthenticated remote code execution on self-managed instances across every version released over the past 12 years going back to version 7.0. The flaw is caused by an integer overflow during the compilation of crafted regular expressions within Ruby's built-in Onigmo engine, which GitLab bundles in its packages. While GitLab.com and GitLab Dedicated are already patched, self-managed administrators must upgrade immediately, as earlier patches from October 12 did not cover versions prior to 19.2. GitLab has backported fixes to branches 18.11, 19.0, 19.1, and 19.2, and released Sigma detection rules to help identify exploitation attempts.

2a3e280dd3dfb89b:2653.summary: An unauthenticated payment reuse vulnerability, designated CVE-2026-115937, affects the Mollie webhook endpoint integration. 2e22a5a9c6b0f8be:2221.summary: Several vulnerabilities have been identified in c-ares, an asynchronous DNS client library, affecting various Ubuntu releases. These flaws include improper parsing of SOA replies and sortlist strings, inadequate limits on DNS compression pointer hops and name lengths, and a lack of proper record count validation before memory allocation when processing DNS responses. A remote attacker could exploit these issues to cause denial of service via excessive resource consumption or crashes, or potentially execute arbitrary code. Ubuntu has published security updates to resolve these vulnerabilities across supported package versions.

claims.support_span: It was discovered that c-ares did not properly validate record count fields before allocating memory when parsing DNS responses. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause c-ares to use excessive resources, resulting in a denial of service.

ff6f68426a988fe3:3248.summary: A vulnerability, CVE-2026-58202, exists in OpenReception appointment booking software prior to version 2.0.0, where account confirmation links in emails are constructed from the unvalidated request Host header rather than a trusted tenant domain. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this via the POST /api/auth/resend-confirmation endpoint by injecting a malicious Host header alongside a pending invitee's email address. When the invitee clicks the password/account confirmation link generated in the resulting email, the one-time token is sent directly to the attacker. The attacker can then complete the account registration on the legitimate tenant domain and register an attacker-controlled passkey to fully hijack the account before the victim can use it. The issue can be mitigated via front proxy restrictions or updated to version 2.0.0.

72dee010971cff31:2891.summary: A high-severity vulnerability, CVE-2026-115895, has been identified in Happy DOM versions 17.0.0 through 21.0.4. The flaw stems from an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-33943 within `packages/happy-dom/src/module/ECMAScriptModuleCompiler.ts`, where named ECMAScript module import aliases are accepted without validating if they are valid JavaScript binding identifiers before insertion into generated destructuring bindings. When JavaScript evaluation is enabled, an attacker can supply malicious HTML or module sources with invalid aliases that compile into valid default initializers, resulting in arbitrary code execution in the Node.js host process. The vulnerability can be triggered via JSON module import attributes and is patched in version 21.0.4.

18d2f324f662423b:2044.summary: HTTP::Headers::ActionPack versions before 0.10 for Perl contain a CPU exhaustion vulnerability caused by unescaped Accept-Language header ranges being interpolated directly into regular expressions. 0ca8687e75c193e4:2843.summary: WordPress plugin Prime Mover up to version 2.2.1 is vulnerable to unauthenticated PHP Object Injection via base64-encoded comments during migration search-and-replace routines. When an administrator performs a migration export or restore, the plugin decodes and unserializes this input without proper class restrictions. 6666dbd1ec16281e:3325.summary: WordPress plugin aBlocks up to version 2.17.0 contains an authenticated privilege escalation vulnerability via its registration REST endpoint (`/ablocks/v1/form-builder/registration`). The endpoint is registered with `__return_true` permission callbacks and directly reads `roleSlug` parameters from untrusted block attributes without verifying that the form type is set to registration during execution. This allows an attacker with Contributor-level access to manipulate block attributes, bypass save-time checks, and elevate their account to an Editor role through `WP_User::set_role()` and session cookie generation. Escalation is capped below administrator roles due to built-in safety checks rejecting management capabilities.
6666dbd1ec16281e:3325.one_liner: A privilege escalation vulnerability in WordPress plugin aBlocks <= 2.17.0 allows Contributors to escalate their privileges to Editor.
6666dbd1ec16281e:3325.bottom_line: Authenticated contributors can exploit unverified REST endpoints in aBlocks <= 2.17.0 to escalate their privileges up to the Editor role.

claims.support_span: The aBlocks – Gutenberg Blocks, User Dashboard Builder, Popup Builder, Form Builder & Animation Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 2.17.0 via the `/ablocks/v1/form-builder/registration` REST endpoint.

claims.text: This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Contributor-level access and above, to escalate their WordPress role to Editor or any other non-administrator role and receive a fully authenticated session at the elevated privilege level via `WP_User::set_role()` and `wp_set_auth_cookie()`.

23645b983b014ff2:9472.summary: Sonar Research argues that AI model routing should be treated as a quality control mechanism rather than just a cost-saving lever. Current routing strategies often flatten performance into a single metric, ignoring critical dimensions like security, functional correctness, reliability, and maintainability. Research shows that models diverge significantly in these areas, with some producing higher rates of security debt or runtime defects despite similar aggregate benchmarks. The industry is encouraged to match model capability to the specific criticality of the task, such as using frontier models for security-sensitive code while utilizing lower-tier models for routine work.
23645b983b014ff2:9472.one_liner: Stop routing all code to frontier models; you need to account for security and maintainability debt, not just cost and latency.
23645b983b014ff2:9472.bottom_line: Effective AI coding strategy requires routing tasks based on specific quality dimensions like security and reliability rather than defaulting to the most expensive model.

claims.text: The industry has decided routing is a cost lever, but the empirical case for treating it as a quality control is at least as strong.

14d2b3640a647b73:16285.summary: Research into LLM jailbreaks demonstrates that these attacks are prompt-level manipulations rather than model defects, meaning they cannot be permanently patched through fine-tuning or weight adjustments. Because the space of possible prompts is open-ended, security teams must focus on measuring attack success rates against specific model versions rather than seeking a universal fix. The research highlights that jailbreaks are an inherent property of how models are instructed to follow conflicting directives.

077ef200d3e00808:6620.summary: A sophisticated UEFI bootkit dubbed BlackX has been deployed against diplomatic entities in Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, and Turkmenistan, orchestrated by the China-linked APT41 group. The malware is an updated version of BlackLotus and exploits the patched Secure Boot bypass vulnerability CVE-2022-21894 (Baton Drop) to load malicious code before the OS starts. Complete mitigation requires manually adding the expired Windows Production PCA 2011 certificate to the Secure Boot UEFI Forbidden List (DBX), a step many organizations have neglected. Attackers leverage existing administrator or physical access to drop an RC4-encrypted installer and extensionless payload, subsequently installing Machine Owner Keys to execute arbitrary EFI files.

91e38cb5730dbf2e:5707.summary: Traditional cybersecurity policies rely on database encryption, network security, and access controls, but fail to protect data once decrypted and processed across cloud platforms, analytics tools, and AI pipelines. Because data must be read to be used, breaches or future quantum decryption can expose sensitive plaintext information. To mitigate this risk without stalling operations, policymakers and organizations are turning to vaultless, keyless pseudonymization. This approach replaces sensitive identifiers like names, social security numbers, and payment cards with structurally valid substitutes, eliminating central vaults as single points of failure and rendering stolen data useless to threat actors.

94d51fe2d20419a9:6228.summary: Dutch security firm Eye Security remotely pushed over 2 million updates to disable an abandoned background updater associated with Time4Popcorn, a fork of the Popcorn Time streaming app. The updater communicated over unencrypted HTTP and fetched unverified binaries with SYSTEM or root privileges, leaving an estimated 2.5 to 3 million Windows computers and 250,000 to 350,000 Macs vulnerable to complete takeover, ransomware, or botnet recruitment via domain hijacking. 01e4cb452dcd254f:6415.summary: Eight intermediate certificate authority (CA) private keys issued by Indian CA eMudhra Limited were compromised due to insufficient randomness during the certificate generation process. This cryptographic weakness enables malicious third parties to derive private keys, sign unauthorized public TLS certificates, and execute meddler-in-the-middle (MitM) attacks or session hijacking against targeted domains. Major browser and OS vendors have responded by revoking and untrusting the affected intermediate certificates, while eMudhra has also revoked them. Palo Alto Networks recommends immediate public key infrastructure (PKI) discovery, emergency trust store updates, and strict certificate revocation checking.

5aaac97d85d09699:14091.summary: NVIDIA Sentry is a security software framework designed to monitor AI agents at runtime and enforce policies governing their access to models, tools, and data. Operating out-of-band on NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPUs as part of the NVIDIA OpenShell reference architecture, Sentry runs in a hardware trust domain entirely outside the agent's reach to prevent compromised agents from altering their restrictions. It uses DOCA Flow to establish silicon-accelerated layer-4 firewalls and DOCA Tower (built on Envoy) as a transparent proxy to inspect agent-to-model network communications. By combining network inspection with memory introspection, NVIDIA Sentry provides tamper-evident traceability and continuous runtime security enforcement for autonomous agents.

34b1f6d3e02dc582:5979.summary: A zero-day kernel soundness vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-72714, affects the Rocq proof assistant by desynchronizing the universe checking state after closing a local module. Specifically, when a module locally disables universe checking (`Local Unset Universe Checking`), the global flag is restored but the universe graph retains the disabled state. This permits Hurkens' paradox to derive False, allowing the creation of certified mathematical forgeries for Millennium Problems—such as the Riemann Hypothesis and P=NP—that successfully pass proof verification checks with clean axiom whitelists.

9a2d5fc223a764a4:5729.summary: A critical remote code execution vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in the open-source AI coding agent OpenCode was patched silently as part of a refactor without a security advisory or CVE identifier.
